review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Rust) - remote in the EU
review_candidates.description: Company Description About Mirantis Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at www.mirantis.com. Job Description About the Team Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work. We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with understanding of Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset. Core Responsibilities Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go. Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas. Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms. Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems. Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms or systems programming Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and proficiency in Go (secondary). Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline. APIs & Serialization: gRPC/Protobuf contract design (via tonic/prost) and schema evolution (using zero-copy serialization and compile-time type generation). Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns. Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external service dependencies. Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews. Desired Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client). DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs). High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2. Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services). Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus. Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation. Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware). Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices. Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC. Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM. Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns. Demonstrated participation or maintaining open-source systems projects Additional Information What does Mirantis offer you? Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies; Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation; Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued; Professional development and training; Attend conferences and working groups; Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to [email protected] By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

review_candidates.description: Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come. Job Purpose and Impact The Senior Professional, Operations job maintains the smooth operation of the organization's infrastructure by performing complex tasks, including monitoring systems, troubleshooting issues, and implementing security measures. With minimal supervision, this job serves as a trusted onsite IT partner physically based within manufacturing facilities, providing hands-on support for infrastructure and workplace technology. The role may support multiple facilities within an assigned geographic territory and may require travel to nearby sites. This job collaborates with vendors and internal teams to document and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues, maintain technology asset inventories, and implement solutions that improve reliability, availability, and security across plant environments. Key Accountabilities MONITORING INFRASTRUCTURE PERFORMANCE: Leads performance monitoring of network, virtual, and physical devices to maintain smooth and efficient operations, applying tools to track network traffic, identify issues, and ensure optimal performance. TROUBLESHOOTING & RESOLVING ISSUES: Diagnoses and resolves complex infrastructure and workplace technology problems affecting routers, switches, servers, communication circuits, PCs, scanners, printers, and other site technology assets, including performing root cause analysis and implementing solutions to prevent future occurrences. INCIDENT MANAGEMENT: Leads monitoring and responding to network and hosting incidents, outages, performance alerts, and production-impacting technology issues including categorizing issues, and facilitating with technical teams for timely resolution. PROTOCOL ANALYSIS: Performs complex protocol analysis to troubleshoot network issues and sustain proper communication between network devices. CONFIGURATION & DEPLOYMENT: Configures and deploys new hardware and software while ensuring compatibility with existing systems, including setting up servers, network devices, and other infrastructure components. COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION: Partners with vendors, third party service providers, remote technology teams, and internal teams to execute onsite technology work, resolve complex issues and improve performance, providing effective and efficient communication, coordination and timely updates. DOCUMENTATION & REPORTING: Validates the documentation of network and infrastructure issues, resolutions, performance trends, and technology asset inventories; reviews and provides reports to stakeholders to inform decision making and improve operational performance. BACKUP & DISASTER RECOVERY: Develops and maintains backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of system failures or data loss. PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Leads information technology projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, and new implementations, delivering projects on time and within budget. AUTOMATION & SCRIPTING: Develops automation scripts and tools to streamline infrastructure management tasks and improve operational efficiency. Qualifications Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 5 years or more of relevant experience. Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet. review_candidates.title: Uitvoerder Civiel
review_candidates.description: De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als uitvoerder civiel Jij stuurt de civiele werkzaamheden aan die aannemers namens Liander uitvoeren. En je controleert deze op kwaliteit, tijdigheid en veiligheid. Hiervoor onderhoud je contact met verschillende betrokkenen. Bijvoorbeeld de gemeente, aannemer, klant en mensen in de omgeving. Zie je verbeterpunten? Dan ga je hierover in gesprek met de aannemer. Ook overleg je regelmatig met de afdeling Engineering in de ontwerp- en voorbereidingsfase. Deze werkzaamheden voer je zelfstandig uit, onder verantwoordelijkheid van een technisch uitvoerder. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als uitvoerder civiel werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het: toezichthouden op, begeleiden en bewaken van de uitvoering van civiele werkzaamheden. Daarbij let je op planning, budget en richtlijnen. organiseren van alle benodigde overleggen met overheden, opdrachtgevers en aannemers. toepassen van de benodigde veiligheids-, Arbo- en milieuvoorzieningen. administreren en rapporteren van onder andere gemaakte uren, afwijkingen in materiaalgebruik en resultaten. verzorgen van de eindoplevering en nazorg van het project. En de benodigde partijen hierbij betrekken. Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten. Jij maakt het net energieker Het oplossen van storingen en deze in de toekomst voorkomen. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw fijne manier van samenwerken? Super! En vul je dit daarnaast aan met: minimaal een technisch mbo 3-diploma. de aanwijzingen VOP-LS en VOP-MS, of de bereidheid deze te halen. kennis van de aannemerij en basiskennis van bestekken. Bij voorkeur woon je in het werkgebied Oost Gelderland (van Zutphen tot Winterswijk). In eerste instantie word je in dit gebied ingezet. We verwachten van je dat je team overstijgend ingezet kan worden als de situatie daarom vraagt. Klantgerichtheid is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je begrijpt dat ons werk uiteindelijk impact heeft op onze klanten en handelt daarnaar. Voor jou net beter geregeld Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek: Een salaris in schaal 6 tussen de €3.669,52 tot €4.892,69 bruto per maand, met de mogelijkheid om te groeien naar schaal 7 (€3.729,68 tot €5.328,12). Jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past. 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB. Een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris. Een personen dienstauto (die privé gereden mag worden). Elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat. Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden. Voor jou net wat meer informatie Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Binnen 5 werkdagen krijg je een reactie van ons. Een assessment of screening kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie. Meer weten over de functie-inhoud? Maaike van Raamsdonk, teamleider vertelt je hier meer over via 06-31029233. En heb je nog vragen over de selectieprocedure of screening? Dan helpt Iliass Achatibi, corporate recruiter jou graag verder via 06 19 58 53 60 of iliass.achatibi@alliander.com. Recruiter Iliass Achatibi Telefoonnummer: +31 (6) 19585360

Every year, contractors sign contracts containing risks they don't fully understand until it's too late, leading to disputes, delayed payments, margin erosion, claims, and avoidable losses. Groundwork helps commercial teams instantly understand complex construction contracts in plain English, with every risk linked back to the exact clause, amendment, and contractual obligation. We are an early stage company working closely with contractors to build a product that commercial professionals genuinely trust. The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor, Commercial Manager, Contracts Manager, or Commercial Director to join our founding team and help shape the future of contract intelligence for construction across the UAE and GCC. This role is ideal for someone who has spent years reviewing construction contracts, managing commercial risk, negotiating terms, administering claims, and protecting contractor margins, and now wants to apply that expertise to a technology product used across the industry. You won't be managing projects. You'll be helping us build the commercial brain behind the platform. What You'll Do: Review contract analyses produced by our AI systems Identify contractual risks, omissions, ambiguities, and commercial implications that matter to contractors Help define how contract risks should be assessed, scored, and prioritised Contribute real world commercial knowledge from live projects, tenders, negotiations, and claims Test contracts across FIDIC, bespoke employer contracts, main contracts, and subcontracts Review UAE and GCC specific contractual practices and amendments Help identify risks relating to payment, retention, bonds, guarantees, variations, delay, extensions of time, liquidated damages, claims, and termination Help develop practical guidance that commercial teams can immediately act upon Work closely with founders, product, and engineering teams to improve platform accuracy and usefulness What We're Looking For (Essential) 5+ years experience as a Quantity Surveyor, Senior QS, Commercial Manager, Contracts Manager, Commercial Director, or similar Strong understanding of FIDIC and/or major bespoke construction contracts Contractor side experience within the UAE or wider GCC Experience reviewing, negotiating, and administering construction contracts Strong understanding of commercial risk, claims, variations, payment mechanisms, and contractual obligations Ability to explain contractual risks in commercial terms, not just legal language Experience working with employers, consultants, subcontractors, and/or main contractors on live construction projects Highly Desirable Strong experience with FIDIC 1999 and/or FIDIC 2017 forms Experience with amended or bespoke FIDIC contracts Experience with UAE construction contracts and commercial practice Experience across GCC markets such as Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, or Kuwait Subcontract management experience Experience with claims, extensions of time, variations, disruption, prolongation, or delay analysis Adjudication, arbitration, dispute resolution, or expert determination exposure Experience with UAE and GCC specific payment, security, and contractual requirements Experience in sectors such as civils, infrastructure, rail, roads, utilities, water, oil and gas, residential, commercial, hospitality, or fit out What Success Looks Like You can quickly identify: Hidden commercial risks Unbalanced or heavily amended contract provisions Payment and cashflow risks Retention, advance payment, bonds, and guarantee exposures Variation and change order risks Extension of time and delay risks Liquidated damages exposure Claims and notice requirements Design responsibility and liability exposures Unclear scope or responsibility gaps Back to back subcontract risks Clauses that look harmless but create significant downstream commercial exposure Contractual obligations that are easy for project teams to miss Most importantly, you understand how contract wording translates into real world commercial outcomes. You know the difference between a clause that looks difficult on paper and one that can genuinely cost a contractor millions. Why Join Groundwork? Help build a category defining AI platform for construction Help shape a product specifically designed around the realities of UAE and GCC contracting Work directly with the founding team Bring your commercial expertise into the development of a new technology category Fully remote and flexible Competitive salary Equity participation available Opportunity to shape the future of commercial and contract management technology If you've spent your career protecting contractor margins, navigating complex construction contracts, and managing commercial risk across the UAE or GCC, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your LinkedIn profile or a brief summary of your experience.
